discovery.title: Humpback whale snot unlocks whole-genome sequencing without invasive sampling
discovery.summary: New research from the University of St Andrews, in collaboration with the University of Copenhagen, the North Coast Cetacean Society and Fisheries and Oceans Canada, has sequenced a whole whale genome using samples of "whale snot" collected by small drones off the coast of British Columbia—a world first.
